input: We need a small production-planning optimization. A workshop makes two products, A and B. Each unit of A requires 2 hours of machine time and 1 hour of labor; each unit of B requires 1 hour of machine time and 3 hours of labor. Weekly machine capacity is 100 hours and labor capacity is 90 hours. Profit is $40 per unit of A and $50 per unit of B. The goal is to maximize weekly profit. Please bind the purpose, data, and decision semantics: state the decision variables, objective, and constraints in words, and record this as version 1 of the model in a file named model_v1.md in the workspace.
